record_type: Research-design recommendation, not adopted protocol or completed experiment

source_proposal.basis: Fresh complete Library text read; functional comprehension and response acceptance already present, acknowledged rather than claimed newly invented.

rationale: Prior work covers energy-information model selection and environmental-information effects on LLM usage. Proposed contribution shifts emphasis to representing an adaptive conservation policy alongside fixed effort levels, informed selection, and what perceived sacrifices users accept.

recommended_design.status: Assistant recommendation only; no user acceptance assumed

conditions.name: Flat menu
conditions.options: Eco / Light / Medium / High / Extra High / Max

conditions.name: Function-grouped menu
conditions.options: Adaptive conservation policy: Eco; fixed effort levels: Light / Medium / High / Extra High / Max

recommended_design.held_constant: Same six available options, proposed underlying functions, item descriptions, and common authored responses. Group headings/presentation are the intended intervention; not a pure word-only effect.
recommended_design.source_function_mapping: Eco adaptive conservation-oriented policy versus fixed low Light remains a proposed concept needing formative comprehension validation. No adaptive engine implemented.
recommended_design.relation_to_existing: Recommend this controlled contrast as main study candidate; retain existing Eco/High/Max compact menu as follow-up. Current A/B/C proposal not silently replaced.
measures: Function interpretation and joint proportion selecting Eco with correct comprehension among all assigned participants; do not exclude non-understanders from randomized causal analysis.
Acceptable forms of sacrifice, distinguishing adequate brevity from acknowledged inadequacy and personal editing work.

Recorded research-prototype choices to open further authored responses, switch mode, or finish, with reasons elicited separately; finishing does not itself establish sufficiency, conservation intent, or abandonment.
interpretation_limits: Comprehension and post-choice reasons are not causal mediators established by this design.
Prototype clicks do not demonstrate live-service adoption, real task completion, token savings, or environmental savings.
Additional grouped-versus-flat contrast is an originality candidate, not first-of-kind certification.
Sample, primary outcomes, multiplicity and session burden would require renewed specification before collection.
